body.statement: Establish constants \(c,C>0\) such that, for all sufficiently small \(\delta>0\), any \(P,Q\in\mathcal M\) satisfying \(\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\{\int_{\mathcal C_*}(|F_{x,P}-F_{x,Q}|^2+B_Y^{-2}|G_{x,P}-G_{x,Q}|^2)\,ds\,dt+|p_{x,P}-p_{x,Q}|^2\}\le\delta^2\) obey \(\|\mu_P-\mu_Q\|_{L^\infty(I)}\le C\{\log\log(1/\delta)/\log(1/\delta)\}^{\beta-1/2}\), with the exponent unimprovable on a fixed-density, fixed-error Bernoulli-marked submodel.
body.justification: This quantitative modulus is the genuinely open bridge from nearly parametric forward control to the proposed sharp causal sup-norm width.
body.gap: Capitao-Miniconi, Gassiat, and Lehéricy prove an unmarked \(L^2\) density modulus; no result gives the paired marked-channel \(L^\infty\) quotient modulus or freezes all unmarked nuisances in the converse.
body.consumer: Resolving the question turns blind replicate information into an explicit sample-size requirement for simultaneous ADRF precision.
